description: Golden contract for sprite manifest keys, shared by the server that emits them and the software development kit that reads them back. Every `key` below was captured from a live staging manifest. The server suite asserts spriteKey() produces these; the software development kit suite asserts its lookups resolve them. Neither package imports the other, so this file is the only thing holding the two halves together — if either side drifts, exactly one of the two suites goes red.

entries.note: Checksummed Ethereum-Virtual-Machine address — stored and keyed lowercase.
PulseChain — the chain component is the identifier, never the bare number.
Arbitrum — a multi-digit reference, so the key carries two dashes before the address.
Solana mint — base58 is case-significant and must survive verbatim.
Tron — base58 again, under a different non-Ethereum-Virtual-Machine namespace.
Tron numeric id — an address component that is neither hex nor base58.
Kleros asset list — a 32-byte synthetic hash, longer than an address and not lowercased by the server.

lookups.note: A bare number is the form the token list format carries; it must reach the eip155 key.
Bare number as a string resolves identically.
Hex casing carries no meaning, so a checksummed caller still resolves.
Chain 0 is the asset namespace, not eip155-0.
Solana under its identifier — the only form that can name it, since 501 is also an eip155 chain.
